ideas.title: [Feature] Keyboard focus is lost on the points ledger
ideas.summary: After an action on the points ledger, focus jumps to the top of the page, so keyboard users lose their place.
ideas.description:
## Summary

After an action on the points ledger, focus jumps to the top of the page, so keyboard users lose their place.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Sign in to the demo workspace as a member.
2. Open the Points page.
3. Leave the page open for a few minutes and come back.

## Expected

Focus returns to the control that was used, or the next sensible one.

## Actual

Focus moves to the document body.

## Where it is

`lib/points/award.ts:132` handles this. The query does not filter on it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Focus returns to the control that was used, or the next sensible one.
- [ ] A test covers the case.
- [ ] Docs mention the behaviour where agents rely on it.

## Summary

After an action on the points ledger, focus jumps to the top of the page, so keyboard users lose their place.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Sign in to the demo workspace as a member.

## Summary

At 375 px cursor paging overflows horizontally and the main action is cut off.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Sign in to the demo workspace as a member.
2. Open list routes.
3. Repeat the action twice quickly.

## Expected

Everything fits with a 16 px gutter and no horizontal scroll.

## Actual

The page scrolls sideways and the button is half off screen.

## Where it is

`lib/agent-api/create-policy.ts:335` handles this. The value is read without validation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Everything fits with a 16 px gutter and no horizontal scroll.
- [ ] A test covers the case.
- [ ] Docs mention the behaviour where agents rely on it.
